sourceScope: Exact upstream package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, original source and original maintainer test bytes; no runtime dependency projection or test rewriting

install.lifecyclePolicy: Package-manager native defaults; no --ignore-scripts, production-only, optional-dependency or package filtering flags
install.retirement: Disposable installed dependencies removed after negative native runs because free disk fell below1GiB; source, exact upstream manifest/lock, manager, logs and native receipts retained. The old receipt cannot authorize a new execution.

nativeDiscovery.reason: Upstream Vitest0.34.6 rejects --filesOnly; current native inventory requires unsupported list flags

fixedBaseline.rejection: Unchanged upstream assertion expects historical JSON-parser error wording that differs under Node22. No skip, assertion or gate relaxation.

attemptAccounting.corrections: First output inherited unrelated ancestor pnpm workspace; next local clone origin was not rebound to upstream. Both failed receipts retained, with fresh prospective outputs for corrections.

limitations: The complete public100/10 and intermediate30/5 targets remain unmet; one installation is not one qualified change.
Only Node22 and24 available; no incompatible-baseline exclusion to manufacture a pass.
No three-arm timings published because fixed baseline and native discovery reject the candidate. Native full durations are negative diagnostics, not a speed comparison.
Post-native installed-tree diagnostic overlapped deliberate dependency retirement and is inconclusive; no claim about native cache drift.
Installation used a reusable pinned-manager package cache/store on darwin-arm64; OS/network caches not cold.
Installer controller was improved after this observed receipt; its hash names the actual implementation used.
No learning, generation, browser, monorepo or leaderboard superiority claim.
